b:
A sky at daybreak,
the hour of golden sunlight,
flowers in bloom, birds
drinking water

Through ripened fields
a stream winds and runs;
in the clear water
a little dragonfly looks at its face

Rising before the sun,
a group of young women
fetching water in their pots

Oh,
isn't this the good life
crushed
by the hell called the city?

With tears,
I, its lover
note: The title plays on the Tamil words naragam (hell) and nagaram (city), which differ by a single letter.
